IA No. 12973 of 2022
In 
WPSS No. 1686 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Rahul Bhatt, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, Advocate for 
petitioner.
Mr. G. S. Negi, learned Addl. Chief 
Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. Manav Sharma, Advocate for 
the complainant. 
An intervention application has 
been filed by Rahul Aneja S/o Shri Prem 
Nath Aneja. 
It is contended that on his 
complaint, proceedings in question were 
initiated against petitioner and birth 
certificate issued in his favour was 
cancelled. Various other contentions 
have been raised by the learned counsel 
for applicant.
For the facts and reasons 
mentioned in intervention application (IA 
No. 12973 of 2022), the same is 
allowed.
Rahul Aneja shall be heard at the 
time of final hearing.
List this matter on 17.04.2023.
In the meantime, intervener may 
bring on record relevant 
documents/materials, if any, by filing 
objections. 
 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 22.02.2023
Akash
